subject: ela
intro: Pick the theme or best summary.

items.prompt:
Read.

After failing three times, Ana kept practicing until she succeeded. 'Never give up,' she said.

The theme is:
A) give up quickly
B) perseverance (never give up)
C) practice is boring

A short retelling of the key events, without opinion, is a:
A) theme
B) summary
C) title

The central message or lesson of a story is the:
A) theme
B) setting
C) length

Read.

The lion spared the mouse; later the mouse chewed the net that trapped the lion.

The theme is:
A) lions are strong
B) kindness can be repaid, even by the small
C) mice are scary
items.answer: B) kindness can be repaid, even by the small

solution.answer: B) kindness can be repaid, even by the small

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST summary of 'The Tortoise and the Hare'?
A) A tortoise and a hare race; the hare naps, and the steady tortoise wins.
B) I think the tortoise was cool.
C) The hare was fast and green.
items.answer: A) A tortoise and a hare race; the hare naps, and the steady tortoise wins.

steps: Key events, no opinion. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) A tortoise and a hare race; the hare naps, and the steady tortoise wins.

items.prompt:
A summary should NOT include:
A) key events
B) your personal opinion
C) the main characters

Read.

The miser hoarded his gold and trusted no one. In the end he died alone, unmourned.

The BEST theme is:
A) Saving money is always good
B) Greed and distrust lead to a lonely life
C) Gold is heavy
items.answer: B) Greed and distrust lead to a lonely life

steps: His choices caused his loneliness. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Greed and distrust lead to a lonely life

items.prompt:
How do you usually find a story's THEME?
A) by looking at how characters respond to challenges and what they learn
B) by counting the pages
C) by reading only the title
items.answer: A) by looking at how characters respond to challenges and what they learn

steps: Theme emerges from character responses. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) by looking at how characters respond to challenges and what they learn
